description: Defines a finite state machine class for managing the state of a ZeroMQ-based radio receive channel, including state transitions, timers, and status checks.

classes.name: radio_zmq_rx_channel_fsm
classes.description: Finite state machine managing the states of a ZeroMQ radio receive channel, including initialization, data reception, error handling, and stopping.

methods.name: init_successful
methods.description: Sets the state to SEND_REQUEST and starts the timer, indicating successful initialization.

methods.name: on_error
methods.description: Sets the state to STOPPED due to an unrecoverable error.

methods.name: request_sent
methods.description: Transitions the state from SEND_REQUEST to RECEIVE_DATA and restarts the timer upon receiving a request.

methods.name: data_received
methods.description: Transitions the state from RECEIVE_DATA to SEND_REQUEST and restarts the timer upon data reception.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Transitions the state to STOPPED if the FSM is currently running.

methods.name: async_task_stopped
methods.description: Sets the state to STOPPED when the asynchronous task signals stop.

methods.name: is_running
methods.description: Checks if the FSM is in an operational state (SEND_REQUEST or RECEIVE_DATA).

methods.name: has_pending_response
methods.description: Returns true if the current state is RECEIVE_DATA, indicating a pending response.

methods.name: has_wait_expired
methods.description: Checks if the wait timer has expired, indicating timeout for request or data wait states, and restarts the timer if expired.
